description: THE BRANCH THIS CASE PINS: the first arm of MAIN-PARA's outermost IF, the EIBCALEN = 0 guard at :172-174. It is the only path on which no communication area travels, so the program cannot know who called it. Its sibling arm - first entry, where :179 moves LOW-VALUES to CORPT0AO - is pinned by case02, and the two are deliberately kept apart: collapsing them would duplicate one arm and leave this one with no case at all. CONTROL FLOW: :173 moves 'COSGN00C' into CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM, then :174 performs RETURN-TO-PREV-SCREEN. Inside that paragraph the defaulting IF at :542-544 is NOT taken - CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM is already 'COSGN00C' from :173, so the fallback MOVE at :543 never runs and the observed target comes from the guard rather than from the paragraph's own default. :545 moves WS-TRANID ('CR00', declared at :38) into CDEMO-FROM-TRANID, :546 moves WS-PGMNAME ('CORPT00C', declared at :37) into CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM, and :547 moves ZEROS into CDEMO-PGM-CONTEXT. :548-551 then issues EXEC CICS XCTL PROGRAM(CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM) COMMAREA(CARDDEMO-COMMAREA). TERMINATION (gate G30, rule R7): the XCTL transfers control and never comes back, so the EXEC CICS RETURN TRANSID(WS-TRANID) at :199-202 is UNREACHABLE on this path - the termination is XCTL, not RETURN_TRANSID, and a translation performing both would have invented a behaviour. The other terminal shape this program has, SEND-TRNRPT-SCREEN falling through :580 GO TO RETURN-TO-CICS into the EXEC CICS RETURN at :585-591, is likewise not reached, because no map is sent. NO SCREEN IS SENT: SEND-TRNRPT-SCREEN is never performed, so POPULATE-HEADER-INFO at :609-628 never runs and not one title, date or time byte is produced. 'sends' is therefore empty and 'cursorField' is null, and both are positive assertions that nothing was painted - asserting a TITLE01O, a CURDATEO or a MONTHLYL cursor here would fabricate a send the COBOL does not perform. WHY TWO MESSAGE CHANNELS ARE STILL ASSERTED: :169-170 moves SPACES to WS-MESSAGE and to ERRMSGO OF CORPT0AO unconditionally, BEFORE the guard is even evaluated, so both message fields are observably blank on a path that paints nothing - WS-MESSAGE at its declared PIC X(80) and ERRMSGO at the symbolic map's PIC X(78). NO DISPLAY IS EMITTED: the program's only two DISPLAY verbs are :210, inside PROCESS-ENTER-KEY, and :529, inside WIRTE-JOBSUB-TDQ's WHEN OTHER arm; neither paragraph is reached, so no DISPLAY_LINE is expected. NO RECORD IS WRITTEN: EXEC CICS WRITEQ TD at :517 is not reached, so 'expectedWrites' is empty, which the differ treats as the positive assertion that nothing was written. Java has no transient data queue, so :517 is reproduced through an explicit job-submission port whose eighty-byte content is identical, and the binding key JOBS names the TDQUEUE(JOBS) that app/csd/CARDDEMO.CSD:499 defines as RECORDSIZE(80) RECORDFORMAT(FIXED) BLOCKFORMAT(UNBLOCKED) DISPOSITION(MOD); no dataset name is written into source (gate G46). STATELESSNESS (gate G37, rule R6): this program keeps no server-side state. The communication area, the attention identifier and the screen values all travel in the payload, and the observable proof here is the returned navigation carrying CDEMO-PGM-CONTEXT back at ZEROS exactly as :547 leaves it, alongside the 'CR00' and 'CORPT00C' that :545-546 set. The area carried forward is this program's own uninitialised CARDDEMO-COMMAREA - 160 bytes as app/cpy/COCOM01Y.cpy lays it out - with only those three fields plus the CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM of :173 actually written, because :176's MOVE DFHCOMMAREA(1:EIBCALEN) TO CARDDEMO-COMMAREA sits in the arm not taken. INVOCATION (gate G51): unitKind is CONTROLLER_POJO. ReportRequestController is constructed through its own constructor and its handler called as a plain Java method - no MockMvc, no TestRestTemplate, no servlet container, no web application context and no HTTP anywhere in the path, so the guard is reached with nothing between the assertion and the decision. The transaction package created no service beneath this controller, which is why the controller itself is the unit. WHY NO AID IS DECLARED (practice B8): EIBAID is read only by the EVALUATE at :184-195, which lives in the inner ELSE that this path never enters. Naming a key here would imply one was consulted, which is a worse misstatement than an omission, so the absence is declared deliberately and explained rather than papered over with a plausible-looking DFHENTER. DETERMINISM (practice B7): the clock is pinned to 2022-07-19T23:12:34, tying this fixture to the analysed baseline revision Ver: CardDemo_v1.0-15-g27d6c6f-68; nothing is left to the real clock. On this path it is also unobservable, because the MOVE FUNCTION CURRENT-DATE at :611 sits inside POPULATE-HEADER-INFO, which is not reached. The code page is named explicitly as US-ASCII and is never the platform default. G38 IN ITS CORRECTED FORM: CORPT00C copies NEITHER CSSETATY NOR CSSTRPFY. Its COPY list at :138-149 is exactly COCOM01Y, CORPT00, COTTL01Y, CSDAT01Y, CSMSG01Y, CVTRA05Y, DFHAID and DFHBMSCA, and the only DFH colour or attribute constant referenced anywhere in the program is DFHGREEN at :448, on the success path rather than this one. There is no DFHRED MOVE and no '*' marker in this program to assert, and none is invented here; the red on ERRMSG is DECLARATIVE in app/bms/CORPT00.bms:218-221 (ATTRB=(ASKIP,BRT,FSET), COLOR=RED, LENGTH=78, POS=(23,1)), not something the program moves. For the same reason no attribute entry is claimed for this send-free path. CORPT00C also references NEITHER thank-you literal: its only CCDA-* references are CCDA-MSG-INVALID-KEY at :193, CCDA-TITLE01 at :613 and CCDA-TITLE02 at :614. RETURN CODE: 0. The program contains no CALL 'CEE3ABD' and never moves anything to RETURN-CODE, so gate G35 has no subject in this folder; the value is stated explicitly rather than omitted, because an absent key would bind nothing and the model refuses it. PROVENANCE (practice B12): every expected value here is STATICALLY DERIVED by structured reading of app/cbl/CORPT00C.cbl, cross-checked against app/cpy-bms/CORPT00.CPY, app/bms/CORPT00.bms, app/csd/CARDDEMO.CSD and app/cpy/COCOM01Y.cpy, COTTL01Y.cpy, CSDAT01Y.cpy and CSMSG01Y.cpy. It is NEVER captured from a live COBOL execution, which is empirically impossible in this environment - no z/OS or CICS runtime, an indexed file handler reported as disabled, no Language Environment CEE* services, and DFHAID, DFHBMSCA and DFHATTR absent from the repository (risk R-A, escalated rather than absorbed). Those inputs are read-only and appear here purely as provenance; not one byte of app/cbl, app/cpy, app/cpy-bms, app/bms or app/csd is modified (practice B3), and nothing about the source behaviour is tidied (practice B5). GOVERNING RULES: review_rules returns exactly one line, 'No user rules provided', so ZERO user-specified rules govern this fixture. That absence is not licence to lower the bar - practices B1 (no placeholders), B3, B5, B7, B8 and B12 are held as binding instead. This case must produce a diff count of zero, and the module is not complete until the count is zero across all twenty of its cases (gate G18).
